body:
Several years ago, I wrote a book called We Make the Road by Walking . Lots of groups – from families to small groups to churches to groups of churches – have used it as a way to get re-aligned and re-rooted.

  

 2020-2021 would be a great time to do that.

  

 Sunday, August 30 is the best time to begin with Chapter 1, although you can begin and adapt it for your own schedule as needed.

  

 If you’re looking for more resources, there’s a Facebook page devoted to the book here: https://www.facebook.com/wemaketheroadbywalking

 The book is available as an audiobook, and it has been re-formatted as a daily devotional called Seeking Aliveness.
